purpose: Exercise a real local API request-rate 429 without GPU job admission or submission
stop_conditions: GPU jobs outstanding before or after the probe
Unexpected response status, body or Retry-After
No rate-limit response within the request or time bound
limits: This is a prospective deployment-level replay of an already known isolated middleware mechanism, not a new failure family.
Requests briefly consume this local API's rate-limit budget; no jobs are submitted or changed.
The diagnostic bundle retains the 429 and omits the response body, so it cannot identify the middleware cause by itself.
